final: WITH g AS (SELECT q.constructorId AS cid, c.nationality AS nat, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qualifying q JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = q.constructorId GROUP BY q.constructorId, c.nationality), t AS (SELECT nat, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g GROUP BY nat), r AS (SELECT g.cid, g.nat, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS ratio FROM g JOIN t ON t.nat = g.nat), a AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM r WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.cid, r.nat, r.cnt, r.ratio, r.ratio / a.avg_ratio AS rel FROM r JOIN a ON a.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rel DESC LIMIT 10
